name: Suriname
summary: Five horizontal bands of green, white, red, white and green, the red twice as tall, with a yellow star in the centre. Adopted at independence from the Netherlands in 1975.
origin: From 1959 Suriname used a white flag with five coloured stars joined by an ellipse, representing its main ethnic groups. For independence on 25 November 1975 a new design by Jack Pinas, chosen in a competition, emphasised unity rather than separate groups.

colors.name: Green
colors.meaning: Fertility and hope for a new Suriname.

symbols.name: Yellow star
symbols.description: A five-pointed star in the red band.
symbols.meaning: Unity, and a golden future through sacrifice.

history.label: Autonomous country in the Kingdom of the Netherlands
history.note: Five stars joined by an ellipse.

facts: Suriname is the smallest sovereign country in South America.
Dutch is its official language, unique in South America.
The red band is twice the height of the green bands.
clues: Green, white, red, white and green bands with a yellow star in the red.
Its predecessor had five stars joined by an ellipse.
Adopted at independence from the Netherlands in 1975.
